import duckdb
import ggsql
from shiny import App, ui
from shinywidgets import output_widget, render_altair


# The bundled CSV must remain alongside this app file.
DATA_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("mtcars.csv")

if not DATA_PATH.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Could not find {DATA_PATH.name}. Place it in the same directory as this app."
    )

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute(
    "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mtcars AS "
    "SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(?)",
    [str(DATA_PATH)],
)

SQL_QUERY = """
SELECT
  CAST(cyl AS VARCHAR) AS cylinders,
  AVG(mpg) AS avg_mpg
FROM mtcars
GROUP BY cyl
ORDER BY cyl
"""

VISUALISE_CLAUSE = """
VISUALISE cylinders AS x, avg_mpg AS y
DRAW bar
LABEL x => 'Number of cylinders', y => 'Average fuel economy (mpg)'
"""

average_mpg_by_cylinders = con.execute(SQL_QUERY).df()

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.tags.head(
        ui.tags.style(
            """
            .dashboard-container {
                max-width: 900px;
                margin: 2rem auto;
            }
            .dashboard-caption {
                color: #4b5563;
                font-size: 1.05rem;
                margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            }
            """
        )
    ),
    ui.div(
        {"class": "dashboard-container"},
        ui.h1("Average MPG by Number of Cylinders"),
        ui.p(
            "This chart compares average fuel economy across vehicle groups "
            "with different cylinder counts, highlighting how MPG changes by engine size.",
            class_="dashboard-caption",
        ),
        ui.card(
            ui.card_header("Fuel economy comparison"),
            ui.card_body(output_widget("mpg_by_cylinders_chart")),
        ),
    ),
)


def server(input, output, session):
    @render_altair
    def mpg_by_cylinders_chart():
        return ggsql.render_altair(average_mpg_by_cylinders, VISUALISE_CLAUSE)


app = App(app_ui, server)

SELECT
  CAST(cyl AS VARCHAR) AS cylinders,
  AVG(mpg) AS avg_mpg
FROM mtcars
GROUP BY cyl
ORDER BY cyl
VISUALISE cylinders AS x, avg_mpg AS y
DRAW bar
LABEL x => 'Number of cylinders', y => 'Average fuel economy (mpg)'
